summary: Register a one-shot listener that is removed before invocation, including under re-entrant emit.

target.notes: The helper must install Node-compatible once state/wrapper behavior and remove the registration before calling the listener so a re-entrant emit does not call it again.

semantics.raw_listener_identity: Node exposes a once wrapper through rawListeners

caveats: A naive 'call then remove' implementation is wrong for re-entrant emit.
removeListener(event, originalListener) must be able to remove a pending once registration.

tests.name: one shot
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; e.once('x',()=>n++); e.emit('x'); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);

tests.name: reentrant emit still once
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; e.once('x',()=>{n++; e.emit('x')}); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);
